Concept dictionary

Source: vignettes/articles/concept-dictionary.Rmd
concept-dictionary.Rmd

The concepts rendehR extracts from each source, generated from the configuration files shipped with the installed package (rendehr_concepts_config.csv for time series, rendehr_duration_concepts_config.csv for medication exposures). Flat admission-level variables (age, sex, outcomes, length of stay, …) come from SQL and are listed in vignette("harmonized-data").

A tick means the source has at least one configuration row for the concept. Range is the plausible range used by clean_by_range() and by clean = "range" in the wide loaders; the pipeline itself keeps every value. To add or override a concept for a project, see vignette("concepts").

Time-series concepts

130 concepts from 538 configuration rows.

Medication exposures

108 exposure concepts from 545 configuration rows.

Reading the configuration in R 

cfg <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "rendehr_concepts_config.csv", package = "rendehR"))
subset(cfg, concept_name == "lactate",
       c(source, table_name, match_value, unit, min_value, max_value, conversion))
validate_concept_config(cfg)   # the checks run_concepts() applies to every row
